cohort: 644 male newborns of postnatal age < 48 h and birth weight between 2.5 and 4.0 kg
finding: In this study of Ghanaian newborns, maternal age was inversely related to penile length and babies delivered by caesarean section had the lowest mean penile length.
mod_finding: Babies delivered by caesarean section had the lowest mean penile length.
